title: Late-Correction Multiplier Table for Residential Electricity Supply Rebills
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply off-peak rebill, the calendar days from the corrected line's posting date to the correction date are counted; at 30 days or more the over-billed amount is multiplied by the long late-correction factor of 1.05, from 7 to 29 days by the short late-correction factor of 1.02, and below 7 days it is taken as it stands.

**Counting.** The correction date less the posting date of the corrected off-peak line, in calendar days.

| Line posted (hypothetical) | Correction date | Days | Over-billed amount is |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-01 | 2026-03-03 | 30 | multiplied by 1.05 |
| 2026-02-01 | 2026-03-02 | 29 | multiplied by 1.02 |
| 2026-02-01 | 2026-02-08 | 7 | multiplied by 1.02 |
| 2026-02-01 | 2026-02-07 | 6 | taken as it stands |

**Example (hypothetical).** An over-billed amount of 41.58 USD corrected 45 days after posting becomes 43.659 USD before the final rounding.
